q: What is 35% of 640?
A trader buys a table for Rs 1250 and sells it at a loss of 12%. What is the selling price?
What is the simple interest on Rs 4000 at 7.5% per annum for 3 years?
Rs 840 is divided among three persons in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. What is the smallest share?
exp: Total parts = 12, one part = 840/12 = 70, smallest share = 3 x 70 = 210.

q: What is the LCM of 12, 18 and 30?
The average of five numbers is 24. If one of the numbers, 14, is removed, what is the average of the remaining four?
exp: Sum = 5 x 24 = 120; remaining sum = 106; average = 106/4 = 26.5.

q: A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
exp: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day, so time = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

q: A train 150 m long runs at 54 km/h. How long does it take to pass a pole?
A room is 8 m long, 6 m wide and 3 m high. What is the total area of its four walls?
exp: Area of four walls = 2(l + b) x h = 2(8 + 6) x 3 = 84 m².

q: Solve for x: 5(x - 2) = 3x + 6.
The angles of a triangle are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. What is the largest angle?
exp: Sum of angles 180°; one part = 180/9 = 20°; largest = 4 x 20 = 80°.

q: In a class of 50 students, 30 like tea, 25 like coffee and 10 like both. How many like neither?
exp: Students liking at least one = 30 + 25 - 10 = 45; neither = 50 - 45 = 5.

q: Which activity is most suitable for introducing the idea of a fraction as part of a whole to Class VI learners?
options: Memorising rules for adding fractions with unlike denominators
Solving a long list of fraction problems from the textbook
Dictating the definition of a fraction to be copied down
Folding paper strips or circles into equal parts and shading some of them
exp: Concrete, hands-on activities such as paper folding build conceptual understanding before symbolic rules.

q: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 11?
exp: For 2728: (2 + 2) - (7 + 8) = -11, a multiple of 11 (2728 = 11 x 248). The others give differences -7, -2 and -3.

q: What is the compound interest on Rs 8000 for 2 years at 10% per annum compounded annually?
The price of an article is increased by 20% and then the new price is decreased by 20%. What is the net change in the price?
exp: Final price = 1.2 x 0.8 = 0.96 of the original, i.e. a 4% decrease.

q: What is the HCF of 84 and 126?
exp: 84 = 2²x3x7 and 126 = 2x3²x7, so HCF = 2x3x7 = 42.

q: The marked price of a shirt is Rs 900 and a discount of 15% is given. What is the selling price?
The circumference of a circle is 44 cm. What is its area? (take π = 22/7)
exp: 2πr = 44 gives r = 7 cm; area = πr² = 22/7 x 49 = 154 cm².

q: A shop sold 120, 150, 90 and 140 units in four consecutive months. What is the average monthly sale?
If 6 workers build a wall in 10 days, how many days will 4 workers (working at the same rate) take?
exp: Work = 6 x 10 = 60 worker-days; days for 4 workers = 60/4 = 15 (inverse proportion).

q: How many bricks of size 20 cm x 10 cm x 6 cm are needed to build a wall 12 m long, 20 cm thick and 3 m high? (ignore mortar)
exp: Wall volume = 1200 x 20 x 300 = 7,200,000 cm³; brick volume = 1200 cm³; number = 7,200,000/1200 = 6000.

q: If a + b = 10 and ab = 21, what is the value of a² + b²?
Which of the following is NOT a criterion for congruence of two triangles?
options: SSA (two sides and a non-included angle)
exp: SSA does not guarantee congruence in general; SAS, ASA and SSS are valid criteria (RHS is valid only for right triangles).

q: A sum of Rs 5000 earns a simple interest of Rs 1200 in 4 years. What is the rate of interest per annum?
If the cost price of 15 articles equals the selling price of 12 articles, what is the profit percent?
exp: 15 C = 12 S gives S = 1.25 C, so profit = 25%.

q: In an election between two candidates, the winner got 55% of the votes and won by 3000 votes. How many votes were cast in total?
exp: Margin = 55% - 45% = 10% of total = 3000, so total = 30000.

q: A car travels 180 km at 60 km/h and returns the same distance at 90 km/h. What is its average speed for the whole journey?
What is the volume of a cylinder of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm? (π = 22/7)
If n(A) = 40, n(B) = 35 and n(A ∪ B) = 60, what is n(A ∩ B)?
A Class VI student writes 3/4 + 2/5 = 5/9. What misconception does this error most likely show, and what should the teacher infer?
options: The student adds numerators and denominators separately and does not grasp the need for a common denominator
The student has not memorised the multiplication tables
The student is careless and has no misconception
exp: Adding top and bottom separately is a classic conceptual error; diagnosing it guides remedial teaching.

q: The average age of 6 persons is 30 years. A new person joins and the average becomes 31 years. What is the age of the new person?
exp: New total = 7 x 31 = 217; old total = 6 x 30 = 180; new person = 217 - 180 = 37.

q: Three bells ring at intervals of 6, 8 and 12 minutes. If they ring together at 9:00 a.m., when will they next ring together?
exp: LCM of 6, 8, 12 = 24 minutes, so the next common ring is at 9:24 a.m.

q: A father is 3 times as old as his son. After 12 years he will be twice as old as his son. What is the son's present age?
exp: Let son = x: 3x + 12 = 2(x + 12) gives x = 12.

q: An exterior angle of a triangle is 110° and one of its interior opposite angles is 45°. What is the other interior opposite angle?
exp: Exterior angle = sum of the two interior opposite angles, so the other = 110° - 45° = 65°.

q: 18 is what percent of 72?
What is the difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs 5000 at 8% per annum for 2 years?
exp: Difference for 2 years = P(R/100)² = 5000 x 0.0064 = 32 (CI = 832, SI = 800).

q: Milk and water are in the ratio 3 : 2 in 20 litres of a mixture. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1 : 1?
exp: Milk = 12 L, water = 8 L; for 1 : 1 water must be 12 L, so add 4 L.

q: Pipe A fills a tank in 20 minutes, pipe B in 30 minutes, and pipe C empties it in 60 minutes. If all three are open, how long to fill the tank?
Two trains of lengths 100 m and 140 m run in opposite directions at 40 km/h and 32 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other?
exp: Relative speed = 72 km/h = 20 m/s; distance = 240 m; time = 240/20 = 12 s.
